notes: One entry per election (docs/ballot-implementation-plan-2026-09-24.md §5.1). Display labels are never identifiers: every deadline has a stable key. Dates are calendar dates in the state's timezone; time_local is wall-clock time there.

WA.how_it_works: Everyone here votes by mail. Your ballot is mailed by Oct 16. Return it in a drop box by 8 p.m. Nov 3, or mail it a week early so the postmark is on time.

CA.far_note: To get a ballot by mail, register by Oct 19. After that, you can register and vote in person through Election Day.

UT.how_it_works: Every active voter gets a ballot by mail on Oct 13. Return it in a drop box by 8 p.m. Nov 3, or mail it a week early: postmarks don’t count. On the envelope, add the last four digits of your ID or Social Security number.
UT.far_note: To get a ballot by mail, register by Oct 23. After that, you can register when you vote in person.
